description: An application submitted under Section 96a of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a non-material amendment in connection with the planning permission DC/25/138943)  dated 16  May 2025, for the variation of Condition (2) Approved Plans in order to allow:- the existing caf‚ slab is to be retained, with associated amendments to the fencing around the holding area and garden centre to address level changes; part of the fence line is to be repositioned into the service yard; the fence adjacent to the caf‚ frontage is to be moved closer to the pond, with the services enclosure incorporated within the fenced area; the wall along Beckenham Hill Road is to be retained, with the mesh / anti-climb fencing above removed; the fence between the service yard and pond is to be replaced due to its poor condition; the electric vehicle charging layout is to be revised, with an additional accessible space provided, resulting in a net increase of one parking space; pedestrian crossing markings are to be added within the car park; and damaged block paving along the access road is to be replaced with tarmac at Former Homebase, 10 Beckenham Hill Road SE6.
site_name: HOMEBASE, 10 BECKENHAM HILL ROAD, BROMLEY, SE6 3NU
